assumptions: Correction cell rings represent physical source spaces with horizontal floor/ceiling boundaries.
Contacts describe adjacency, not traversability or EnergyPlus surface pairing.
Only explicit openings are represented; absent observations do not establish a solid wall.
Source boundary identity follows cell identity and ring order; topology edits need identity migration.

Interior partition/wall thickness treated as zero per geometry contract; wall centerlines placed at clean round-number positions (7.5m single meeting-room divider; corridor 3.0-5.0m; office dividers at 3.75/7.5/11.25m) consistent with measured pixel gaps within a few percent.

South wall window positions assumed to mirror north wall windows exactly (x=1.95-5.55m and 9.45-13.05m), based on South_view.png upper-zone dimension chain (1950/3600/3900/3600/1950=15000mm) rather than assuming one window per small office; this is a simplification since the interior office grid (3.75m bays) does not align 1:1 with this 2-window facade pattern.
All interior corridor-office/meeting-room door widths and exact positions are approximated from visible arc symbols, not individually dimensioned.
Interior door head heights assumed standard 2.1m (unobserved).
Plan spaces were compiled deterministically from the declared footprint and physical partition segments; no snapping, extension, clipping, or inferred partition was applied.

generation.notes: Deterministic plan partition compilation from explicit original-image pixels. Calibration and drawing fidelity remain unverified.

geometry_feedback.note: Effective declaration dimensions, not verified drawing dimensions. Bare world values mean metres. Compare with original annotations; no unit or scale is inferred.

unresolved: Exact correspondence between the 4 south-row offices and the 2 large south-facade windows is not fully resolved from the drawing; offices 2 and 3 may each receive only a partial share of a window rather than each office having its own dedicated window.
Interior door exact widths/positions at office/meeting-room to corridor junctions are approximate.
Pixel-to-world calibration was supplied by the caller and was not independently verified.
